summary.text: Son of Teleon and Zeuxippe, Athenian Argonaut who alone leapt overboard at the Sirens' song and was saved by Aphrodite at Lilybaeum.

story.text: When Orpheus' counter-melody held the crew at the Sirens' isle, Butes alone was overcome and swam toward the deadly song; Aphrodite snatched him up and settled him in Lilybaeum, where she bore him Eryx.
